people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”
translations.bsb: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you.”
translations.kjv: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
translations.asv: and the land which I gave unto Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
